questions.question: Given the functions: f(x) = ax², g(x) = ax² + c for a < 0 and c > 0. Then which of the following statements is true about the graph of f and g?

options.A: The graph of f is upward parabola, and the graph of g is obtained from that of f by lifting it downward by c units.
options.B: The graph of f is a downward parabola, and the graph of g is obtained from that of f by shifting it to the right by c units.
options.C: The graph of f is an upward parabola, and the graph of g is obtained from that of f by lifting it upward by c units.
options.D: The graph of f is a downward parabola, and the graph of g is obtained from that of f by lifting it upward by c units.

questions.explanation: Since a < 0, the parabola opens downwards. The graph of g(x) is the graph of f(x) shifted vertically upwards by c units (since c > 0).

questions.question: Consider the right-angled triangle ΔABC below, where AC = 5 cm and BC = 4 cm. Then which one of the following is the length of BD? (Image: Right triangle ABC with right angle at B, altitude BD drawn from B to hypotenuse AC)
questions.explanation: In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse creates similar triangles. AB² = AC² - BC² = 25 - 16 = 9, so AB = 3 cm. Using the geometric mean property: BD = (AB * BC) / AC = (3 * 4) / 5 = 12 / 5 = 2.4 cm.

questions.question: Consider the test results of 20 students in a given class: 13 14 14 15 19 18 13 15 16 16 17 18 15 13 14 16 14 18 16 16. Which one of the following numbers is the mode of the above data?
questions.explanation: The mode is the number that appears most frequently. The number 16 appears 5 times in the list, which is more than any other number.

questions.question: Let r₁ and r₂ be the roots of the quadratic equation: 2x² + 3x - 4 = 0. Then which one of the following is equal to (1/r₁²) + (1/r₂²)?
Which of the following statements defines a circle?

options.A: It is the set of points in a plane formed by the intersection of two secants in the plane.
options.B: It is the set of points in a space formed by the intersection of two secants in the space.
options.C: It is the set of points in a space each of which is equidistant from a fixed point in the space.
options.D: It is the set of points in a plane each of which is equidistant from a fixed point in the plane.

questions.explanation: The definition of a circle is the set of all points in a plane that are at a fixed distance (radius) from a fixed point (center) in that plane.

questions.question: A spherical ball has diameter 30 cm. Then what is its surface area (in cm²)?
questions.explanation: Radius r = 30/2 = 15 cm. Surface area = 4πr² = 4π(15)² = 4 * 225 * π = 900π cm².

questions.question: Consider the figure given below (a triangle path from A to B to C to D). Which one of the following vectors is equal to AB + CD + BC?
questions.explanation: AB + BC + CD = AC + CD = AD. This is the vector sum for the path from A to D.

questions.question: Which one of the following relations is a function?

options.A: R = {(x,y): x,y ∈ R and y² = x}
options.C: R = {(x,y): x,y ∈ R and y = x²}
options.D: R = {(x,y): x,y ∈ R and y⁴ = x}

questions.explanation: A function must have exactly one output (y) for each input (x). In y = x², each x has a unique y. In y² = x, x=4 has y=±2. In |y| = x, x=4 has y=±4. In y⁴ = x, x=16 has y=±2.

questions.explanation: The integral of a sum is the sum of the integrals. This is a fundamental property of integrals.

questions.question: What is the average rate of change of y = f(x) with respect to x on the interval [a,b]?
questions.explanation: The average rate of change of a function f(x) on the interval [a, b] is defined as the change in y divided by the change in x: (f(b) - f(a)) / (b - a).

questions.question: Which one of the following is the decomposition of the rational expression (3x² + 5x - 1) / ((x + 2)(x + 1)²) as a sum of partial fractions?

options.C: Z(x,y) = 5,000x + 1,000y subject to x + y ≤ 35 and 60x + 5y ≤ 400, x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0.
options.D: Z(x,y) = 5,000x + 1,000y subject to x + y ≤ 35 and 60x + 5y ≤ 400, x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0.

questions.question: Which one of the following is NOT a power function?
questions.explanation: A power function has the form f(x) = k * xⁿ, where the exponent is a constant. f(x) = 3ˣ is an exponential function (variable is in the exponent).

Which one of the following sets is the solution of: log₃x + log₃(x - 2) = 1?

questions.question: Which one of the following statements is true about the given numbers and points on the number line?

options.A: There is a one-to-one correspondence between the set of natural numbers and points on the number line.
options.B: There is a one-to-one correspondence between the set of rational numbers and points on the number line.
options.C: There is a one-to-one correspondence between the set of irrational numbers and points on the number line.
options.D: There is a one-to-one correspondence between the set of real numbers and points on the number line.

questions.explanation: The real numbers (R) have a one-to-one correspondence with the points on a line, which is the Completeness Axiom. Rationals and irrationals alone do not have this property.

options.B: The lender assumes no risk when giving out a loan.

questions.question: Given the set B = {0, {-2, 0}}, what is the power set of B?

questions.question: Which of the following statements is NOT true about the mean of a given data set?

options.A: It is highly affected by extreme values (outliers).
options.B: The sum of the deviations of the items from the mean is always zero.
options.C: It must always be one of the actual data values present in the set.
options.D: It uses every value in the data set for its calculation.

questions.explanation: The mean is the average, and it does not have to be one of the actual data values. For example, the mean of {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} is 3, which is a data point, but the mean of {1, 2, 3, 4} is 2.5, which is not.

questions.question: What is the area of the parallelogram spanned by the vectors u = i - 2j + k and v = 2i + 2j - k?
questions.explanation: The area is the magnitude of the cross product of the two vectors. u x v = ( (-2)(-1) - (1)(2) )i + ( (1)(2) - (1)(-1) )j + ( (1)(2) - (-2)(2) )k = (2-2)i + (2+1)j + (2+4)k = 3j + 6k. Magnitude = √(0² + 3² + 6²) = √(9 + 36) = √45 = 3√5.

questions.question: The water bill for a past month of a certain family was Birr 200. The bill consisted of a fixed charge of Birr 20 plus a charge of Birr 2 per cubic meter for the water used in the month. How many cubic meters of water did the family consumed for the past month?

questions.question: At a certain fruit shop, one mango is being sold for Birr 10 and one banana is being sold for Birr 5. If 30 fruits of mangos and bananas were purchased from the fruit shop for Birr 200, how many of the fruits were bananas?
questions.explanation: Let m be mangos, b be bananas. m + b = 30. 10m + 5b = 200. Dividing by 5: 2m + b = 40. Subtract the first equation: m = 10. Therefore, b = 20.

questions.question: A lady wants to surprise her boyfriend on his birthday by inviting him and their friends a buffet dinner at a hotel. The maximum budget for the dinner was Birr 8,000. questions.explanation: Area = ∫₋₁¹ (x²-4x+3)dx + ∫₁³ (x²-4x+3)dx. The first part is positive, the second is negative. Calculating the definite integrals: ∫₋₁¹ (x²-4x+3)dx = [x³/3 - 2x² + 3x]₋₁¹ = (1/3 - 2 + 3) - (-1/3 - 2 - 3) = 4/3 + 16/3 = 20/3. ∫₁³ (x²-4x+3)dx = [x³/3 - 2x² + 3x]₁³ = (9 - 18 + 9) - (1/3 - 2 + 3) = 0 - 4/3 = -4/3. Total area = 20/3 + |-4/3| = 24/3 = 8.

questions.question: Let p and q be propositions. Which one of the following propositions is a tautology?
questions.explanation: (p ∧ q) ⇒ (p ∨ q) is always true. If both p and q are true, then it is true that at least one of them is true. This is a logical truth.
